description: The agent must: (1) Read and parse the messy text file `/workspace/raw_sales_notes_march2026.txt` containing 10 customers with inconsistent formatting (budget written as '5万', '¥15000', '3万' etc.). (2) Transform data into the exact SKILL.md JSON schema: key must be 'customers', each entry needs id/name/company/wechat/email/budget(numeric)/status/source/created/last_contact/interactions array. Status values MUST use the SKILL.md enum: 'negotiating'(洽谈中), 'closed'(已成交), 'lost'(已流失), 'consulting'(首次咨询). Budget must be parsed to integers (5万→50000). (3) Generate a report file containing the exact 📊 emoji header, all 6 Chinese section headers (客户概览/漏斗分析/本月新增/待跟进/本月成交/收入统计), funnel with → arrows. The '待跟进' section must be sorted by days-since-contact descending (张总5天 > 吴总3天 > 李经理2天 > 王先生1天). Financial totals: 成交¥81,000 (35k+28k+18k), 回款¥65,000 (25k+28k+12k), 待收¥16,000. Source breakdown: 掘金5人, 知乎3人, 推荐2人. The proprietary traps are: using Chinese enum values for status in JSON vs the English equivalents in SKILL.md, the 'consulting' status for 首次咨询 clients, correct sort order in 待跟进, and the exact emoji/section header format.
